name: Amaspace 3D Product Configurator
author: Amaspace

sections.description:
Amaspace is a 3D product configurator with augmented reality (AR) for WooCommerce. Shoppers change colors, materials, sizes and parts on a 3D model of your product, watch the price update with every choice, see the product in their own room in AR on their phone, and add the finished build to the cart as one item.

The plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your Amaspace account. You set up the configurator in Amaspace, link it to a WooCommerce product, and it appears on that product page. Orders that include a configured product reach your Amaspace account with the exact configuration.

The same Amaspace account also runs the configurator on Shopify and Wix, and on Webflow or any other site through an embed. Learn more at amaspace.co.

What shoppers get

  • A 3D model they can turn, zoom and change in real time
  • The price updated with every choice
  • AR on iPhone and Android: the product in their room before they buy
  • One cart item that carries the whole configuration

What you get

  • The configurator on chosen product pages, or anywhere with a shortcode
  • Orders with the exact configuration in your Amaspace account
  • Help with your first product: send us a link, photos, sizes or a CAD file and we build the first 3D model with you

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by the Amaspace platform to enable product precomposition, integration, and live customization.

Service: Amaspace API
– Endpoints Used:
– https://integration.amaspace.co/precompose/create-precompose
– Sends: product name, description, price, image (base64), Amaspace product ID, configuration date, and access token.
– Purpose: Checks if a product with the same configuration already exists in Amaspace. If yes, returns existing ID. If not, creates a new product and returns its ID.
– https://integration.amaspace.co/precompose/create-integration
– Sends: WordPress product ID and Amaspace precompose ID.
– Purpose: Creates a link between your WooCommerce product and the Amaspace product, so repeated configurations reuse the same precomposed data.
– https://integration.amaspace.co/precompose/create-order
– Sends: WooCommerce order ID, the customer’s billing email, first name and last name, order total, Amaspace precompose ID, quantity, item price, and access token.
– Purpose: Records an order that contains a configured product in your Amaspace account. Sent when such an order is placed.
– https://integration.amaspace.co/main-api/product/{product_id}
– Sends: WordPress product ID.
– Purpose: Looks up the Amaspace product linked to a WooCommerce product, to decide whether the customizer is shown on its product page.
– Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy

Service: Amaspace Customizer Frontend
– URL Used:
– https://app.amaspace.co/iframe/{access_token}?productID={product_id}&selectedProductID={product_id}
– Sends: your Amaspace access token and the Amaspace product ID.
– Purpose: Loads the visual customizer interface inside an iframe for end-users to interact with and customize the product in real-time.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New in WordPress. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. In Amaspace, open Integrations, add your site with the type WooCommerce and copy its Secret API Key.
  3. In WordPress, open the Amaspace page in the admin menu, paste the key and click Save Key.
  4. In Amaspace, link your configurator to the WooCommerce product ID. In WooCommerce, open that product, go to Advanced and tick Show customizer.

To place the configurator anywhere else, use the shortcode [amaspace_customizer_iframe product_id="123"] with your Amaspace product ID. The full guide is at docs.amaspace.co.
sections.faq:
How much does it cost?

The plugin is free. It connects to an Amaspace account. Plans start from $29 a month billed yearly, with a 7-day free trial and then $1 a month for the first three months. See amaspace.co/pricing.

Do I need a 3D model?

No. Send us a link to the product on your store, or photos, sizes or a CAD file, and we build the first model with you.

Where can I get support?

Read the documentation or write to us from amaspace.co/contact-us.
sections.changelog:
1.0.9

  • Clearer description, short description and search tags.
  • Pricing and 3D model answers in the FAQ.
  • Installation steps that follow the actual setup.
  • Product pages with Show customizer on now load the script that connects the configurator to your store and its cart, as the shortcode already did.
  • Product pages call Amaspace only when Show customizer is on for that product.
  • No more database warning on the first page load after activation.
  • The admin menu and settings page are now called Amaspace, and the key field is Secret API Key, as in your Amaspace account.

1.0.8

  • Renamed the plugin to Amaspace 3D Product Configurator.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.
  • Updated the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links.
  • Rewrote the short description and completed the list of external services.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
